arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 200 cohort_definition_id, cohort_definition_name, cohort_definition_description FROM omop.cohort_definition ORDER BY cohort_definition_id;

SELECT TOP 100 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id, COUNT_BIG(*) AS n_exposures, COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS n_persons FROM omop.drug_exposure de JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%contracept%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ethinyl estradiol%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%levonorgestrel%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%norethindrone%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%norgestimate%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%desogestrel%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%drospirenone%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%etonogestrel%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%medroxyprogesterone%' GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id ORDER BY n_persons DESC;

SELECT TOP 100 de.drug_source_value, COUNT_BIG(*) AS n_exposures, COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS n_persons FROM omop.drug_exposure de WHERE LOWER(de.drug_source_value) LIKE '%contracept%' OR LOWER(de.drug_source_value) LIKE '%ethinyl%' OR LOWER(de.drug_source_value) LIKE '%levonorgestrel%' OR LOWER(de.drug_source_value) LIKE '%norethindrone%' OR LOWER(de.drug_source_value) LIKE '%norgestimate%' OR LOWER(de.drug_source_value) LIKE '%desogestrel%' OR LOWER(de.drug_source_value) LIKE '%drospirenone%' OR LOWER(de.drug_source_value) LIKE '%etonogestrel%' OR LOWER(de.drug_source_value) LIKE '%medroxyprogesterone%' GROUP BY de.drug_source_value ORDER BY n_persons DESC;

SELECT TOP 100 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id, COUNT_BIG(*) AS n_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT dx.person_id) AS n_persons FROM omop.device_exposure dx JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = dx.device_concept_id WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%contracept%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%intrauterine%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%iud%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%implant%' GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id ORDER BY n_persons DESC;

arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 100 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Condition' AND standard_concept='S' AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%venous thromboembolism%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%venous thrombosis%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%pulmonary embolism%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%deep vein thrombosis%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(concept_name) IN ('venous thromboembolism','pulmonary embolism','deep vein thrombosis') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, concept_name;

SELECT TOP 100 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id, COUNT_BIG(*) AS n_exposures, COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS n_persons FROM omop.drug_exposure de JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id WHERE (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ethinyl estradiol%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%estradiol%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%norethindrone%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%levonorgestrel%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%etonogestrel%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%medroxyprogesterone%') AND (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%oral tablet%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%pack%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%intrauterine system%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%implant%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%injection%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%prefilled syringe%') GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_class_id ORDER BY c.concept_name;

WITH exposure_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(de.person_id AS bigint) AS person_id,
        CAST(de.drug_exposure_start_date AS date) AS index_date,
        c.concept_id,
        c.concept_name,
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ethinyl estradiol%'
             AND (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%oral tablet%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%} pack%')
             AND LOWER(c.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%estradiol 1 mg / norethindrone%'
                THEN 'combined oral contraceptive'
            WHEN LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%levonorgestrel%intrauterine system%'
              OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%etonogestrel%implant%'
              OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%medroxyprogesterone%injection%'
              OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%medroxyprogesterone%prefilled syringe%'
              OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%depo-provera%'
              OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%norethindrone 0.35 mg%'
                THEN 'progestin-only method'
        END AS method
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
), indexed AS (
    SELECT method, person_id, MIN(index_date) AS index_date
    FROM exposure_candidates
    WHERE method IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY method, person_id
), eligible AS (
    SELECT i.*
    FROM indexed i
    JOIN omop.observation_period op
      ON op.person_id = i.person_id
     AND op.observation_period_start_date <= i.index_date
     AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day, 365, i.index_date)
), vte_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (4133004, 440417)
    UNION SELECT 4133004 UNION SELECT 440417
    UNION SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (37163265,37163260,37163283)
), migraine_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 318736
    UNION SELECT 318736
), outcomes AS (
    SELECT e.method, e.person_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN vc.concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vte_12mo,
           MAX(CASE WHEN mc.concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS migraine_12mo
    FROM eligible e
    LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
      ON co.person_id = e.person_id
     AND co.condition_start_date >= e.index_date
     AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 366, e.index_date)
    LEFT JOIN vte_concepts vc ON vc.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    LEFT JOIN migraine_concepts mc ON mc.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    GROUP BY e.method, e.person_id
)
SELECT method,
       COUNT(*) AS eligible_users,
       SUM(vte_12mo) AS users_with_vte_code_12mo,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(vte_12mo) / COUNT(*) AS decimal(8,3)) AS vte_pct,
       SUM(migraine_12mo) AS users_with_migraine_code_12mo,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(migraine_12mo) / COUNT(*) AS decimal(8,3)) AS migraine_pct
FROM outcomes
GROUP BY method
ORDER BY method;

content.text:
Using OMOP EHR data with each patient’s first observed exposure and requiring 365 days of follow-up:

| Method group | Eligible users | VTE code within 12 mo | 12-mo VTE rate | Migraine code within 12 mo | 12-mo migraine-code rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Combined oral contraceptives | 7,001 | 45 | 0.643% | 635 | 9.070% |
| Progestin-only methods | 26,895 | 193 | 0.718% | 1,466 | 5.451% |

Definitions used:
- Combined oral contraceptives: RxNorm drug concepts containing `ethinyl estradiol` and oral tablet/pack terms.
- Progestin-only methods: levonorgestrel IUS, etonogestrel implant, medroxyprogesterone injection/prefilled syringe/Depo-Provera, or norethindrone 0.35 mg pack.
- VTE: descendants of SNOMED deep venous thrombosis and pulmonary embolism concepts, plus explicit VTE concepts.
- Migraine: descendants of SNOMED migraine concept.

Caveat: these are crude observed code rates, not adjusted causal estimates; progestin-only includes non-oral long-acting/injectable methods.
